definitions.explanation: The speed at which music is played.
The speed or pace of an activity or conversation.

examples.japanese: この{曲|きょく}はテンポが{速|はや}い。
examples.english: This song has a fast tempo.

examples.japanese: {会話|かいわ}のテンポがいい。
examples.english: The conversation flows at a good pace.

examples.japanese: もう{少|すこ}しテンポを{落|お}としてください。
examples.english: Please slow down the tempo a bit.

notes:
From Italian "tempo." Used for both musical and general speed/pace.

Common expressions:
- テンポが{速|はや}い/{遅|おそ}い (fast/slow tempo)
- テンポを{上|あ}げる/{落|お}とす (to speed up/slow down)
